missions.printableReason: All tasks (journal setup, writing, five observations) are naturally notebook-first; nothing here is faster or clearer printed.

Optional map-symbols reference card — a small set of cartography symbols is faster to recognise from a printed card than to hand-copy, and it's explicitly offered as an optional extra for the Extension activity, not the core sketch map.
Tables and comparisons are drawn directly in the journal; no diagram or reference card is needed.
Timeline, fact/assumption sorting and the rewritten log entry are all notebook-native writing tasks.
Measurement tables and the field guide sketch are both naturally hand-drawn; no printed reference is needed.
Observation, chart and comparison tasks are all naturally drawn directly in the journal; no reference card is needed.
The build-and-test task is a full experiment (see generated/resources/experiments.json), not a printable; the surrounding planning and reflection tasks are notebook-native writing and sketching.
Decoding, reconstruction and the invented coded message are all notebook-native writing tasks; nothing here is clearer printed.
Observation, grouping and the classification key are all naturally hand-drawn in the journal; the key itself is the learner's own creative structure, not a template to fill in.

Optional printed copy of the station's water system diagram (IMAGE-0012) — the Core 'Trace Water Flow' and 'Interpret Diagrams' activities explicitly require tracing an existing pipework diagram, meeting the PHILOSOPHY bar for a diagram that's genuinely useful printed. Hand-copying it works just as well; the printable is offered only for convenience.
Energy tables, circuit notes and the priority list are all naturally drawn in the journal; the circuit challenges themselves are handled in-app, not on paper.

Optional printed star chart (IMAGE-0014) for the Core 'Measure Angles' activity — measuring accurately with a protractor is easier on a printed, precisely plotted chart than a hand-copied one. Hand-copying the recorded positions still works; the printable is offered only for convenience.
Graphs and comparisons are drawn directly in the journal; no reference card is needed.
Reassembly notes, the timeline and the reconstructed writing are all notebook-native tasks.
The test-and-refine task is a full experiment (see generated/resources/experiments.json); the surrounding inspection, sequencing and design-decision tasks are notebook-native writing.
